name: Cape Canaveral SLC-41
best_known_for: Atlas V's main pad — flew every Atlas V mission including Mars Perseverance + Lucy + Starliner CFT
credit: Fleet launch-site entry added during the LL2 cross-correlation analysis (#306 follow-up). Originally Titan III / Titan IV; rebuilt for Atlas V (2002-) and slated for Vulcan Centaur. ~95 historic launches in our manifest mapped here.
